description: This file defines the Button class, a form element for rendering action buttons within Drupal, including methods for processing and pre-rendering button elements.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A class providing a form action button element with processing and rendering logic.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration info for the button element, including processing and pre-render callbacks.

methods.name: processButton
methods.description: Processes a button element, adding 'formnovalidate' attribute if validation errors are limited.

methods.name: preRenderButton
methods.description: Prepares the button element for rendering, setting type and CSS classes based on properties.
